title: Fictional career-planning scenarios
research_status: editorial prototype; no external fact or client result is asserted
quality_assurance_status: foundation browser tests passed 2026-11-05 for all twelve scenario routes and collection index; verified visible fiction disclosure, noindex, no stylesheet, mobile-width rendering, and public search/sitemap exclusion
disclosure_requirement: Every page and the collection landing page must state prominently that the scenarios are fictional and not based on a real KOV client, engagement, testimonial, placement, or outcome.
evidence_limits: No client records, interviews, testimonials, consents, or verified outcomes were used.
No invented statistic, salary, credential, employer, named person, placement, or service result may be represented as real.
These discussion exercises are not case histories and do not demonstrate KOV services or results.
No keyword demand, SERP, ranking, or SEO qualification is claimed.
release_controls: Keep every page noindex,nofollow and outside public sitemap, search index, and navigation.
Do not remove or obscure fiction disclosures.
For any future real-client story, require documented fact verification, explicit publication consent, and owner approval before drafting or release.
Retain only with separate review and explicit production approval.
